// BEGIN src/shared-resources.js
// Factory-owned resources survive world resets. Instance-owned resources do not.
window.HUNTER_RESOURCES=(()=>{
  const shared=new WeakSet();
  const retain=resource=>{if(resource)shared.add(resource);return resource};
  function retainModel(root){
    root.traverse(o=>{
      retain(o.geometry);
      for(const m of (Array.isArray(o.material)?o.material:[o.material])){
        if(!m)continue;retain(m);
        for(const value of Object.values(m))if(value?.isTexture)retain(value);
      }
    });return root;
  }
  function dispose(root){const steps=disposeSteps(root);while(!steps.next().done){}}
  function* disposeSteps(root){
    const resources=new Set(),stack=[root];let visited=0;
    while(stack.length){
      const o=stack.pop();
      if(o.geometry)resources.add(o.geometry);
      for(const m of (Array.isArray(o.material)?o.material:[o.material])){
        if(!m)continue;resources.add(m);
        // Texture ownership belongs to the texture factory, not to scene materials.
      }
      for(let i=o.children.length-1;i>=0;i--)stack.push(o.children[i]);
      if(++visited%64===0)yield {stage:'Netejant el món anterior',completed:visited,total:null,unit:'objectes'};
    }
    let disposed=0;
    for(const r of resources){
      if(!shared.has(r))r.dispose();
      if(++disposed%64===0)yield {stage:'Alliberant recursos anteriors',completed:disposed,total:resources.size,unit:'recursos'};
    }
  }
  // Object3D.clone serializes userData, which can contain live wheel/pivot refs.
  // Clone the hierarchy first, then remap references without sharing animation state.
  function cloneModel(root){
    const nodes=new Map();
    function copy(source){
      const data=source.userData;let target;
      source.userData={};
      try{target=source.clone(false)}finally{source.userData=data}
      nodes.set(source,target);
      for(const child of source.children)target.add(copy(child));
      return target;
    }
    const result=copy(root),values=new Map();
    function remap(value){
      if(!value||typeof value!=='object')return value;
      if(nodes.has(value))return nodes.get(value);
      if(value.isMaterial||value.isBufferGeometry||value.isTexture)return value;
      if(values.has(value))return values.get(value);
      if(typeof value.clone==='function')return value.clone();
      const out=Array.isArray(value)?[]:{};values.set(value,out);
      for(const [key,item] of Object.entries(value))out[key]=remap(item);
      return out;
    }
    for(const [source,target] of nodes)target.userData=remap(source.userData);
    return result;
  }
  return Object.freeze({retain,retainModel,dispose,disposeSteps,cloneModel});
})();

;
// END src/shared-resources.js

// BEGIN src/high-graphics.js
// Textura procedural repetible per al terreny en qualitat Alt.
// Material compartit: cap malla ni draw call addicional, ni canvis a la física.
window.HUNTER_HIGH_GRAPHICS=Object.freeze({
  createTerrainTextureTask(T,side=256){
    const data=new Uint8Array(side*side*4);
    const hash=(x,y)=>(Math.imul(x+11,73856093)^Math.imul(y+73,19349663))>>>0;
    const noise=(x,y,frequency)=>{
      const sx=x*frequency/side,sy=y*frequency/side,
        ix=Math.floor(sx),iy=Math.floor(sy),
        fx=sx-ix,fy=sy-iy,tx=fx*fx*(3-2*fx),ty=fy*fy*(3-2*fy),
        at=(a,b)=>(hash((a+frequency)%frequency,(b+frequency)%frequency)%10000)/10000;
      return (at(ix,iy)*(1-tx)+at(ix+1,iy)*tx)*(1-ty)+
        (at(ix,iy+1)*(1-tx)+at(ix+1,iy+1)*tx)*ty;
    };
    let nextRow=0,finished=null;
    const advance=(rows=8)=>{
      if(finished)return finished;
      const end=Math.min(side,nextRow+Math.max(1,Math.floor(rows)));
      for(let y=nextRow;y<end;y++)for(let x=0;x<side;x++){
      const large=noise(x,y,8),medium=noise(x,y,32),grains=noise(x,y,64),
        shade=Math.max(209,Math.min(255,Math.round(224+17*large+10*medium+6*grains))),
        i=(y*side+x)*4;
      data[i]=shade;data[i+1]=shade;data[i+2]=shade;data[i+3]=255;
      }
      nextRow=end;
      if(nextRow<side)return null;
    const tex=new T.DataTexture(data,side,side,T.RGBAFormat,T.UnsignedByteType);
    tex.wrapS=tex.wrapT=T.RepeatWrapping;
    tex.magFilter=T.LinearFilter;
    tex.minFilter=T.LinearMipmapLinearFilter;
    tex.generateMipmaps=true;
    tex.colorSpace=T.SRGBColorSpace;
    tex.anisotropy=4;
    tex.repeat.set(20,20);tex.needsUpdate=true;
    tex.name='hunter-terrain-detail-high';
    finished=tex;return tex;
    };
    return {advance,get progress(){return nextRow/side}};
  },
  createTerrainTexture(T,side=256){
    return this.createTerrainTextureTask(T,side).advance(side);
  }
});

;
// END src/high-graphics.js

// BEGIN src/rendering.js
// Inicialització visual separada del joc i de la simulació.
window.HUNTER_RENDERING = Object.freeze({
  create(THREE, visualQuality) {
    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({antialias:true,powerPreference:'high-performance',alpha:false,stencil:true});
    renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(devicePixelRatio,visualQuality.pixelRatio));
    renderer.outputColorSpace=THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
    renderer.toneMapping=THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;
    renderer.toneMappingExposure=visualQuality.exposure;
    renderer.shadowMap.enabled=visualQuality.shadows;
    renderer.shadowMap.type=THREE.PCFShadowMap;

    const scene=new THREE.Scene();
    const viewDistance=visualQuality.viewDistance||12000;
    const camera=new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(58,1,.3,viewDistance);
    scene.fog=new THREE.FogExp2(0xc99f91,visualQuality.fog);

    const hemi=new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xc6e7ff,0x27451e,.82);
    scene.add(hemi);

    const fill=new THREE.DirectionalLight(0x7eb2ff,.32);
    fill.position.set(-250,180,220);
    scene.add(fill);

    const sunDir=new THREE.Vector3(.3,.24,-1).normalize();
    const sun=new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffcf9a,2.35);
    sun.position.copy(sunDir).multiplyScalar(500);
    sun.castShadow=visualQuality.shadows;
    sun.shadow.mapSize.set(visualQuality.shadowSize,visualQuality.shadowSize);
    Object.assign(sun.shadow.camera,{left:-95,right:95,top:95,bottom:-95,near:1,far:900});
    sun.shadow.camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
    sun.shadow.bias=-.0007;
    sun.shadow.normalBias=.07;
    scene.add(sun);
    scene.add(sun.target);

    // La cúpula ha de quedar dins del pla llunyà en el perfil mínim.
    const skyRadius=Math.min(8000,viewDistance*.78);
    const skyGeometry=new THREE.SphereGeometry(
      skyRadius,visualQuality.skySegments[0],visualQuality.skySegments[1]
    );
    const colors=[],positions=skyGeometry.attributes.position;
    const horizon=new THREE.Color(0xffa646);
    const mid=new THREE.Color(0xc76bb6);
    const zenith=new THREE.Color(0x5147b8);
    for(let i=0;i<positions.count;i++){
      const t=Math.max(0,positions.getY(i)/skyRadius);
      const color=t<.35
        ?horizon.clone().lerp(mid,t/.35)
        :mid.clone().lerp(zenith,(t-.35)/.65);
      colors.push(color.r,color.g,color.b);
    }
    skyGeometry.setAttribute('color',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(colors,3));
    const sky=new THREE.Mesh(
      skyGeometry,
      new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({vertexColors:true,side:THREE.BackSide,fog:false})
    );
    scene.add(sky);

    const sunMesh=new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.SphereGeometry(120,20,14),
      new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0xfff0b0,fog:false})
    );
    scene.add(sunMesh);

    const glow=new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.SphereGeometry(175,18,12),
      new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
        color:0xffbd65,transparent:true,opacity:.12,depthWrite:false,fog:false
      })
    );
    scene.add(glow);

    const resize=()=>{
      renderer.setSize(innerWidth,innerHeight);
      camera.aspect=innerWidth/innerHeight;
      camera.updateProjectionMatrix()
    };
    return {renderer,scene,camera,sunDir,sun,sky,sunMesh,glow,resize,viewDistance};
  }
});


;
// END src/rendering.js
// BEGIN src/performance.js
// Diagnòstic de rendiment sense canviar els buffers WebGL durant una partida.
// Reescalar WebGLRenderer en calent provoca fotogrames foscos i pauses de GPU
// en alguns navegadors mòbils. La qualitat es decideix a l'arrencada.
window.HUNTER_PERFORMANCE=Object.freeze({
  create({renderer,maxPixelRatio,minPixelRatio,element=null,compact=false}){
    const ratio=Math.max(.65,maxPixelRatio);
    let frames=0,frameAccum=0,lastDisplay=0,lastFps=0;
    const stats={
      fps:0,frameMs:0,renderCpuMs:0,updateCpuMs:0,terrainCpuMs:0,drawCalls:0,triangles:0,
      pixelRatio:ratio,maxPixelRatio:ratio,minPixelRatio:ratio,
      changes:0,active:false,mode:'fixed'
    };
    function sample({dt,renderCpuMs=0,updateCpuMs=0,terrainCpuMs=0,active=true,now=0,display=false}){
      stats.active=!!active;
      const counts=renderer.info?.render;
      stats.drawCalls=counts?.calls||0;
      stats.triangles=counts?.triangles||0;
      stats.renderCpuMs=renderCpuMs;
      stats.updateCpuMs=updateCpuMs;
      stats.terrainCpuMs=terrainCpuMs;
      if(!active){
        frames=0;frameAccum=0;lastFps=0;
        return stats;
      }
      // Ignorar pauses de la pestanya i salts del rellotge.
      if(dt>0&&dt<=.2){frames++;frameAccum+=dt;}
      if(frameAccum>=.85){
        const fps=frames/frameAccum;
        stats.fps=lastFps?stats.fps*.35+fps*.65:fps;
        stats.frameMs=1000/stats.fps;
        frames=0;frameAccum=0;lastFps=stats.fps;
      }
      if(display&&element&&now-lastDisplay>=350){
        element.textContent='FPS '+Math.round(stats.fps||0)+
          ' · fotograma '+(stats.frameMs||0).toFixed(1)+' ms'+
          '\nCPU joc '+stats.updateCpuMs.toFixed(1)+' ms · terreny '+stats.terrainCpuMs.toFixed(1)+' ms'+
          '\nCPU render '+stats.renderCpuMs.toFixed(1)+' ms · '+stats.drawCalls+' dibuixos'+
          '\n'+Math.round(stats.triangles/1000)+'k triangles · Resolució fixa ×'+ratio.toFixed(2)+
          (stats.hotspots?'\nCPU graella '+stats.hotspots.broadphaseMs.toFixed(2)+' · IA '+stats.hotspots.aiMs.toFixed(2)+
          ' · visual '+stats.hotspots.visibilityMs.toFixed(2)+' · sigil '+stats.hotspots.stealthMs.toFixed(2)+' ms':'');
        lastDisplay=now;
      }
      return stats;
    }
    return {stats,sample};
  }
});

;
// END src/performance.js
